mapper.select: SELECT DATE(date_time) as date_key, COUNT(*) as record_count, IFNULL(SUM(product_sales), 0) as product_sales, IFNULL(SUM(product_sales_tax), 0) as product_sales_tax, IFNULL(SUM(shipping_credits), 0) as shipping_credits, IFNULL(SUM(shipping_credits_tax), 0) as shipping_credits_tax, IFNULL(SUM(giftwrap_credits), 0) as giftwrap_credits, IFNULL(SUM(giftwrap_credits_tax), 0) as giftwrap_credits_tax, IFNULL(SUM(promotional_rebates), 0) as promotional_rebates, IFNULL(SUM(promotional_rebates_tax), 0) as promotional_rebates_tax, IFNULL(SUM(marketplace_withheld_tax), 0) as marketplace_withheld_tax, IFNULL(SUM(selling_fees), 0) as selling_fees, IFNULL(SUM(fba_fees), 0) as fba_fees, IFNULL(SUM(other_transaction_fees), 0) as other_transaction_fees, IFNULL(SUM(other), 0) as other, IFNULL(SUM(total), 0) as total FROM t_amz_transaction_report WHERE amazonauthid = #{amazonauthid} AND marketplaceid = #{marketplaceid} AND DATE(date_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(date_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(date_time) ORDER BY DATE(date_time)

SELECT transaction_type, COUNT(*) as record_count, IFNULL(SUM(product_sales), 0) as product_sales, IFNULL(SUM(product_sales_tax), 0) as product_sales_tax, IFNULL(SUM(shipping_credits), 0) as shipping_credits, IFNULL(SUM(shipping_credits_tax), 0) as shipping_credits_tax, IFNULL(SUM(giftwrap_credits), 0) as giftwrap_credits, IFNULL(SUM(giftwrap_credits_tax), 0) as giftwrap_credits_tax, IFNULL(SUM(promotional_rebates), 0) as promotional_rebates, IFNULL(SUM(promotional_rebates_tax), 0) as promotional_rebates_tax, IFNULL(SUM(marketplace_withheld_tax), 0) as marketplace_withheld_tax, IFNULL(SUM(selling_fees), 0) as selling_fees, IFNULL(SUM(fba_fees), 0) as fba_fees, IFNULL(SUM(other_transaction_fees), 0) as other_transaction_fees, IFNULL(SUM(other), 0) as other, IFNULL(SUM(total), 0) as total FROM t_amz_transaction_report WHERE amazonauthid = #{amazonauthid} AND DATE(date_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(date_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY transaction_type ORDER BY ABS(SUM(total)) DESC
